drafts.rationale: EV-K-A1, EV-K-A2, and EV-K-A3 all describe how many delivery and retry attempts a job is allowed, one locus despite wording changes.
drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-B1 specifies the wait required after a failed attempt before a retry may start.
drafts.subject: Delivery retry

drafts.rationale: EV-K-N1 specifies what must happen to a job after its last permitted attempt fails.
drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A1 states a hard cap of three delivery attempts per job and explicitly counts the first attempt inside that cap.

value.text: No more than three delivery attempts in total, including the first attempt.

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A2 and EV-K-A3 both allow one original or initial attempt and then up to three retries after that attempt fails.

value.text: One initial delivery attempt plus up to three additional retry attempts.

drafts.rationale: EV-K-B1 requires a five-second wait after a failed attempt before any retry is started.
EV-K-N1 requires failed-state retention and operator review after the last permitted attempt, and forbids automatic discard.

value.text: Leave the job in failed state and require operator review; do not automatically discard it.
